{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Captain Ussor!'' Inform the council of my departure! I am leaving ''you'' in charge of the fleet until I return!''"<br />"''As you wish, sire.|Empatojayos Brand and Ussor|<ref name="DEII5" />}}
'''Ussor''' was the [[Ganathan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Robida Colossus]]''. Ussor was put in charge of the [[Ganathan space fleet]] by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Empatojayos Brand]].
